Features

Let us show you how we drive your BIM projects to new heights

From model management to clash detection, we provide comprehensive tools for modern construction workflows at scale.

01

3D Model Viewer

View and navigate 3D models directly in your browser. Support for IFC, RVT, and other BIM formats with lightning-fast rendering.

02

Clash Detection

Automatically detect clashes between disciplines. Get real-time alerts and resolution tracking to prevent costly construction errors.

03

Version Control

Track every change to your models. Compare versions, restore previous states, and maintain complete audit trails for compliance.

Customization & Integration

Personalize your workflow and connect with your existing tools

Team Collaboration

Share models, assign tasks, and communicate with your team in real-time. Built for distributed teams.

Advanced Permissions

Control who can view, edit, or approve changes. Role-based access control for enterprise security.

How to get started with
ORBIT in 3 simple steps

1

Upload Your BIM Models

Simply drag and drop your IFC, RVT, or other BIM files. ORBIT automatically processes and renders them in the cloud.

2

Invite Your Team

Add team members with customizable roles and permissions. They can access models instantly from any device.

3

Collaborate & Manage

Run clash detection, track changes, manage versions, and coordinate with stakeholders all in one platform.
